name: [24.07] OLAP Component Status Template

children.name: Disk IO Usage
children.remark: The maximum percentage of DISK IO in each asset.

children.name: Outstanding Requests
children.remark: Number of queued requests in each Data Center. This goes up when the server receives more requests than it can process. When count > 100.

children.name: Zookeeper Connections/sec
children.remark: The number of connections per second in each Data Center

children.name: Avg Latency
children.remark: Amount of time it takes for the server to respond to a client request (since the server was started) in each data center. When latency > 10 (Ticks).

children.name: Sent Packets/sec
children.remark: Number of client packets sent (responses and notifications) in each data center.

children.name: Received Packets/sec
children.remark: Number of client requests (typically operations) received in each data center.
